source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Which part of an agent system carries out an allowed file-reading operation?

options.text: A reusable skill describing the procedure
options.feedback: A skill supplies instructions about reading the file. It does not itself carry out the external operation.

options.text: The trained model producing a request
options.feedback: The model can propose the action. A separate tool must actually access the file.

options.text: A file-reading tool routed by the harness
options.feedback: The harness checks and routes the request; the file-reading tool performs the allowed operation.

options.text: The generated command displayed in chat
options.feedback: A command can describe the intended operation while remaining text. It needs an executor before the file is read.
